about: House of Zen redesign pitch, IMAGERY lane. Generated mood imagery for the KINTSUGI MORNING design: wabi sabi still life, photographed on film in soft natural window light. Every image is AI-generated illustrative imagery: never House of Zen's store, staff, customers, products or brands, never a real place. Ids = file names in assets/generated/ (16:9 backdrops and 1:1 tiles as JPEG, 4:5 categories generated at 3:4 and cropped to 4:5, 3:2 features and articles as JPEG, cut-outs as transparent PNG). 'aspect' = the delivered aspect, 'calmArea' = where type or glass can sit. Order = delivery order.

images.alt: An indigo stoneware vase mended with gold seams, holding a branch of sage-green leaves on a stone ledge, against a pale plaster wall in morning light
images.prompt: A pale warm limewash plaster wall in early morning window light, seen straight on, wide and very quiet. Soft shoji lattice window shadows, a faint grid of thin soft-edged shadow bars, fall across the wall in the centre and on the right. Far to the right of the frame, its centre about 72 percent across the frame width, stands one hand-thrown stoneware vase with a deep indigo glaze, rounded and slightly asymmetrical, crossed by fine irregular gold kintsugi repair seams, holding one slender branch of sage-green olive leaves that arcs upward. The vase stands on a long rough pale grey stone ledge that runs along the full width of the bottom of the frame. On the ledge just to the right of the vase, a very slim incense stick stands in a tiny plain stoneware holder with a single thin thread of pale smoke rising straight up from its tip. The left 50 percent of the frame is calm, empty, evenly pale plaster with nothing on it. The vase fills about 55 percent of the frame height. Very sharp focus, crisp plaster texture
